title: Mochizuki Honami — Fluffy Break Time〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, to make sure Shibao gets to have his fill of fun with Samo and Minori next week, we gotta play... I mean, exercise to get his body loose.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I definitely just heard you say, “Play”...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's actually completely fine.
He gets bored of simple exercises really easily.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we need to start doing more in order to get his weight under control.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, let's call Rin and the others over.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thank you all for your patience.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, what kinds of activities are we doing today?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our first activity will be red light, green light!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So we are playing games.
Does this really count as exercising?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
This is just a warm-up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I even came up with some special rules♪
Shibao's gonna form a pair with someone new each time, and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?! N-No, you need to stay down or...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Keep it up, Saki!
Shiho and Shibao are right behind you!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Phew...
It's been so long since I last played cops and robbers.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That ended up being a pretty intense game.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Good work out there, Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haha. Look at his tail. He seems so happy.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, let's switch up the teams and play again! I wanna be with Shibao this time♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, relax.
Saki said she wants to be on your team, Shibao.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, he lied down. Does this mean he's tired?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Umm... I think that's part of it, but I'm pretty sure this means he's bored...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?! But he looked like he was having so much fun! His tail was wagging nonstop!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, instead of cops and robbers, let's play with this ball.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, Shibao, let's play fetch!
Go get it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Umm...
He definitely just saw you throw the ball...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And he just watched it fly away.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao...
Everyone agreed to gather here today just for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is your favorite ball, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. He looked the other way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, that's probably to be expected since I've heard that Shibas like to do things at their own pace.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're apparently stubborn too, so I have a feeling that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...
He isn't going to move until I say, “Let's go home.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: His ears perked up when you said that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Shibao.
We're trying to get your weight under control, remember?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, why'd you sit down?
Please, stand up...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I've seen this before!
It's how Shibas say, “No!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Haha! He's not budging at all! And the way you're tugging is making his face scrunch up!>
